description_en: Updates a chatbot's name and description
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot update-instance --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --name '智能客服-小C' --introduction '用于C端问答的机器人' --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstance

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the chatbot instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the chatbot. The maximum length is 50 characters
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的机器人名称，最多50个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the chatbot
parameters.name: introduction

parameters.help_en: The workspace key. If you omit this parameter, the default workspace is used. You can get this key from the Business Management page in your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key
